thread:
zoe: FYI onboarding qlite-quant-v3 (int8) - stress run shows occasional malformed funcall JSONs only when streaming+kv_prefixing are on. low rate (~0.12%) but reproducible. anyone seen similar?

rahul: can you paste a raw example and the exact runtime flags?

zoe: model=qlite-quant-v3-int8, runtime=canary, streaming=true, kv_prefixing=on, batch=12. snippet: 

zoe: ```
{"tool":"search","args":{"q":"coffee shops"}}

��

{"tool":"reserve","args":{"id":321}}
```

mike: NUL + U+FFFD sequence. looks like either zero-padding of a microbatch tail or a truncated multibyte char. is it correlated with seq_len or batching?

zoe: early signal: spikes when seq_len>600 and batch>=10.Standalone non-streaming runs are clean.

canary-bot: Canary snapshot for qlite-quant-v3-int8 (last 6h): total_reqs=54,912, parse_failures=66 (0.12%), streaming=true in 89% of failures, seq_len>600 in 78% of failures.

rahul: triage plan: 1) reproduce with harness forcing chunk splits across multibyte utf boundaries (batch=14, seq=700); 2) run with kv_prefixing off; 3) capture token-id sequences + raw bytes for failures; 4) try lightweight postprocess sanitizer that strips only NULs then retry structured parse.

mike: also try a staging runtime patch that zero-fills microbatch tails before dequant/decoder. low-risk and rules out uninitialized memory.

elle: small caution: sanitizer that strips high-bit bytes could remove emojis people expect. prefer NUL-only strip or replacing U+FFFD with a marker then fail-safe retry.

zoe: ran local replay with NUL-strip sanitizer + single fast non-streaming retry for toolcalls: failures dropped from 28 -> 4 in 45m. capturing remaining artifacts now.

rahul: good mitigation. i'll add chunk checksum instrumentation at streamer boundary to detect in-flight corruption or proxy re-chunking. if checksums mismatch we'll know it's outside kernel.

mike: i'll grep kernel commits for recent int8 streaming optimizations; if there's buffer reuse without clearing, that could explain uninitialized bytes. filing ML-1310 if finds anything.

zoe: temporary routing: pin seq_len>600 to fp16 fallback for 3h. will post capture logs when ready. thanks all. :pray:
